result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers put stuck items first, collapse routine swaps into an expandable count, and give each stuck card a reason and actions on the same screen. B covers the empty state more fully, with both the zero-swap night and the nothing-needs-you case, but its footer hedges about features it would skip. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers put stuck items first, collapse routine swaps into a count that expands, and give each stuck card its reason and actions on the same screen. B wins because it covers reversal (Undo, with its time limit), taking items over (Assign/Handle) and a whole-agent Pause swaps control in an always-visible footer; A has Undo and Take over but no pause anywhere. A states the zero-swap empty state more clearly than B, but its footer reads like unresolved thinking aloud, while B's specifics (the 'agent is alive' line, the Skipped section, the safety-net text) are concrete and on point.
